rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records does not exceed the 0.1% threshold across survey refreshes.
Checks that the latest date is consistent across all StatVars.
Asserts the latest observation date reaches at least 2024 for each CRDC instructional wifi devices StatVar.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) AS max_year, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
